$description: Button colors, pushed into Penpot by build-penpot-tokens.js. They existed only inside the Penpot file until 2026-08-22, where a token import would silently delete them (import replaces same-named sets), and the ten Button variants bind their fills here. Two tiers: `core` holds the seven plain references, emitted verbatim into a core/button set — NOT under the color.* prefix, because the existing Penpot bindings reference them as button.*. `themes` holds the nine genuine color-mix() results from blocks/button.css, flattened per theme, so those hexes drift if the palette moves. Three of the nine (default.text, primary.text, secondary.text) were previously approximated in Penpot as {color.bg} / {color.gray.100}; the real mixes here shift those labels slightly, all still clear AA.
